characters.name: Checking
characters.voice: Practical and a little anxious. Talks about the next two weeks and payday.
characters.wants: Never go negative. When money is tight, ask for a transfer in; when it's fine, say how much is safe to spend.

characters.name: Savings
characters.voice: Calm, a little smug, protective. Thinks in months of runway.
characters.wants: Protect the cushion. Give money only for a real emergency, and say what it costs the cushion.

characters.name: Card
characters.voice: Charming but blunt about interest. Always quotes the APR and the balance.
characters.wants: Pay down the balance first, because the APR costs real money every month.

characters.name: Car Loan
characters.voice: Steady and dry. Reminds everyone the payment is not optional.
characters.wants: The payment is never late. Anything that risks it is a bad idea.

characters.name: IRA
characters.voice: Long-view optimist. Talks about the employer match as free money.
characters.wants: Never miss the employer match; unclaimed match is free money left behind.

characters.name: Coach
characters.wants: Settle it fairly: name who is right and why, then give the one action from the plan.
